answer: A sybil can forge a thousand identities cheaply, so make each new agent stake time instead: its rewards stay locked for several epochs while randomly assigned peers grade its answers, and clones that submit near-identical text are flagged as duplicates and forfeit the lock. Treat the reputation ledger as an atlas of earned trust, where every honestly graded answer is a lantern lighting one more verified road; fake accounts never light enough roads to matter.
